Workflow trigger: CSV row accepted and patient record evaluated
Validation rule: Unique patient ID and retained source filename and row
Validation test: Duplicate ID rejected and result cites exact fixture row

Validation rule: Age 18-85 on 2026-12-31 and encounter in inclusive measurement period
Hypertension true; only explicit hospice=true excludes; unknown values unresolved
Validation test: False condition explicit exclusion and unknown eligibility tests

Validation rule: Only facility_type and access_barrier accepted as dimensions; suppress cells under 11
Validation test: Facility and access groups reconcile; small and complementary cells suppressed

Validation rule: Allowed states remain distinct; patient_declined is never auto-completed
Validation test: Status-state fixtures and decline auto-completion rejection

Validation rule: Date within measurement period and no later than encounter date
Validation test: Period boundaries and post-encounter date rejected

Validation rule: Bounds 50-300 and 30-200; systolic greater than diastolic; units mmHg; no control threshold
Validation test: Boundary values ordering and unit fixtures

Workflow trigger: Completed record is classified as a data_pipeline_defect
Validation test: Wrong role or provenance rejected; original source remains unchanged

Validation rule: Assignment requires owner role due date and allowed barrier

Workflow trigger: Preparer freezes package then distinct reviewer reviews it
Validation rule: Unresolved calculations and open import errors block sign-off; digest must match
Validation test: Different reviewer required; blockers and tamper checks rejected

Workflow trigger: User submits a UTF-8 CSV file
Validation rule: Required header and field types validated; malformed or duplicate rows rejected
Validation test: Malformed row duplicate and boundary fixtures
